onboarding.step1Body: Your map to do things the TOTTO way from day one in store. Seven chapters, short missions and an assistant that reads the manual for you.
onboarding.step2Body: Every lesson adds points. Perfect quizzes, checkpoints validated by your leader and clocking in on Geovictoria count too. Points move your store's League.
onboarding.step3Body: Chapter 01 · Introduction. Eight short lessons to get to know the company, the culture and the SER ecosystem.
